hypotheses: Use the source-justified off-center Q_r=(pi_r.x+epsilon,pi_r.y,z_r) with epsilon=lambda/(4B)>0, c(z_r)=-30 N log B, c'(z_r)=0, N>=1, B>=14, lambda>0, from the admitted pointwise witness.
Let R be a fixed signed permutation matrix R in O(3,Z), so R^T R=I and it induces an isometry of the cubic periodic torus; let b be a fixed torus translation.

Let tau(t) be any source-time reparameterization and a(t) any scalar amplitude. Require at least one t0 with tau(t0)>=1 and a(t0)!=0; no differentiability in time is needed for the spatial advection identity.
Define the candidate transformed field V(t,x)=a(t) R U(tau(t),R^T(x-b)), with U(s,y)=alpha_1(s)W(y) and alpha_1(s)=1/(1+s) for s>=1.

new_mathematical_statement.rigid_covariance: A(V)(t,x)=a(t)^2 R A(U(tau(t),.))(R^T(x-b)), where A(F)=(F dot grad)F; the identity follows from the spatial chain rule and R^T R=I.
new_mathematical_statement.source_witness: At x_r=R Q_r+b (mod torus), A(V)(t,x_r)=[a(t)^2/(1+tau(t))^2]*R*(225 lambda N^2 (log B)^2/B,0,0) for tau(t)>=1.
new_mathematical_statement.nonvanishing: At any t0 with tau(t0)>=1 and a(t0)!=0, A(V)(t0,x_r)!=0 because R is invertible and the source coefficient is strictly positive.
new_mathematical_statement.lean_consequence: Such V cannot equal any valid-input pinned Lean torusSlowVelocity, since that Lean construction has ZeroAdvection. This excludes fixed rigid spatial torus relabelings, arbitrary source-time reparameterizations meeting the witness time, and nonzero scalar rescalings within the stated ansatz.

proof: For fixed t, write y=R^T(x-b), u(y)=U(tau(t),y), and v(x)=a(t) R u(y). By the chain rule D_x v=a(t) R(D_y u)R^T.
Multiply by v(x)=a(t) R u(y): (D_x v)v=a(t)^2 R(D_y u)R^T R u(y)=a(t)^2 R (D_y u)u(y).
The admitted source-specific W chart gives A(W)(Q_r)=(225 lambda N^2 log(B)^2/B,0,0), and U(s)=W/(1+s) for s>=1, hence A(U(s))(Q_r)=(1+s)^(-2) A(W)(Q_r).
Evaluate at x_r=R Q_r+b and t0. The nonzero vector cannot become zero under invertible R or multiplication by a(t0)^2/(1+tau(t0))^2>0.

By the pinned Lean Model.lean definition, ZeroAdvection requires A(V)(t,x)=0 for all t,x. Pinned SlowProgram.lean and TorusSlowMain.lean establish that property for the Lean torus slow construction, so equality is impossible under this explicit transformation class.

replay.tool: Python SymPy 1.14.0, local symbolic check; not CHAD, not Lean compilation or mathematical certification
replay.script:
import sympy as s
X,Y,Z=s.symbols('X Y Z',real=True)
p1,p2=s.symbols('p1 p2',real=True)
q=s.Matrix([X,Y,Z])
c=s.Function('c')
W=s.Matrix([c(Z)*(X-p1),-c(Z)*(Y-p2),1])
A=s.simplify(W.jacobian(q)*W)
a=s.symbols('a',real=True,nonzero=True)
b=s.Matrix([s.Rational(1,7),s.Rational(1,5),s.Rational(1,3)])
rotations=[
 s.Matrix([[0,1,0],[-1,0,0],[0,0,1]]),
 s.diag(-1,1,1),
 s.Matrix([[0,0,-1],[0,1,0],[1,0,0]])]
for R in rotations:
 assert R.T*R==s.eye(3) and abs(R.det())==1
 y=R.T*(q-b)
 V=s.simplify(a*R*W.subs({X:y[0],Y:y[1],Z:y[2]},simultaneous=True))
 predicted=s.simplify(a*a*R*A.subs({X:y[0],Y:y[1],Z:y[2]},simultaneous=True))
 assert all(s.simplify(z)==0 for z in V.jacobian(q)*V-predicted)
 print('PASS det',R.det(),'difference [0,0,0]')
replay.method: Three exact symbolic signed-permutation/translation tests with an arbitrary differentiable c(Z) and symbolic nonzero amplitude a; proof above covers all fixed R in O(3,Z).
